name: overhaul-doc-completo
description: Comandos únicos para rodar o backend (overhaul-doc-server) e o app (overhaul-doc) juntos

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix overhaul-doc-server && npm install --prefix overhaul-doc
scripts.db:setup: npm run --prefix overhaul-doc-server prisma:generate && npm run --prefix overhaul-doc-server prisma:push && npm run --prefix overhaul-doc-server seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix overhaul-doc-server" "npm run web --prefix overhaul-doc"
